lines.zh: 八条细腿在石缝间敲出碎响。
lines.en: Eight thin legs tap a broken rhythm between the stones.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴爬到沙面，只为追你。
lines.en: I crawl from the cave to the sand, only for you.

lines.zh: 传说维度的地底养出我这副小骨架。
lines.en: The Legend dimension's depths grew this small frame of mine.

lines.zh: 影子先动，我的腿才跟上。
lines.en: The shadow moves first; my legs follow after.

lines.zh: 沙粒钻进关节，我照样往前。
lines.en: Sand grinds in my joints and I keep going forward.

lines.zh: 林子里落叶太厚，我踩不出声。
lines.en: Forest leaves are too thick for my steps to make sound.

lines.zh: 两只一起出生，我们从不分开走。
lines.en: We hatched as a pair; we never walk apart.

lines.zh: 沿着洞壁的湿痕，我认得回家的路。
lines.en: I know the way home by the damp trail on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 别嫌我小，我的牙一样咬得动。
lines.en: Do not call me small; these fangs still bite.

lines.zh: 苔藓下藏着我的兄弟姐妹。
lines.en: More of my siblings hide beneath the moss.

lines.zh: 丛林的闷热让我的甲壳发亮。
lines.en: The jungle heat polishes my shell to a shine.

lines.zh: 我顺着你脚印的气味走。
lines.en: I follow the smell your footprints left behind.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水，我绕开每一滴。
lines.en: Water drips from the ceiling; I avoid every drop.

lines.zh: 三十步之内，我闻得到你的汗。
lines.en: Within thirty steps I can smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞顶倒着走，比地上稳。
lines.en: I walk the cave ceiling upside down; it is steadier.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，抖落一层灰。
lines.en: I crawl out of a stone crack and shake off the dust.

lines.zh: 我停在岩壁上，八只眼轮流眨。
lines.en: I rest on the rock face, eight eyes blinking in turn.

lines.zh: 洞里的风把我的腿吹得发凉。
lines.en: Cave wind cools every one of my legs.

lines.zh: 我在等一只走错路的虫子。
lines.en: I am waiting for one insect to take a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 甲壳上的沙粒我一颗颗抖掉。
lines.en: I shake the sand off my shell grain by grain.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我听洞顶的水声。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I listen to water above.

lines.zh: 我的关节一直轻轻发响。
lines.en: My joints keep making a soft, ticking sound.

lines.zh: 沙漠的热气让我躲回阴影里。
lines.en: Desert heat drives me back into the shade.

lines.zh: 传说维度的夜晚，洞穴更冷。
lines.en: Nights in the Legend dimension make caves colder.

lines.zh: 我把腿收在身下，省着力气。
lines.en: I tuck my legs beneath me and save strength.

lines.zh: 洞口那点光，我看得见却不靠近。
lines.en: I see the light at the cave mouth and stay away.

lines.zh: 同伴在远处敲石壁，我听见了。
lines.en: My partner taps the far wall; I hear it.

lines.zh: 二十九点命，够我熬过这一夜。
lines.en: Twenty-nine points of life will last the night.

lines.zh: 你这副身板，够我咬上一季。
lines.en: A frame that size could feed me a whole season.

lines.zh: 我在数你迈步的次数，两条腿。
lines.en: I am counting your strides: two legs, many steps.

lines.zh: 别低头，我的眼睛在石头后面。
lines.en: Do not look down; my eyes are behind the stone.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味盖过了汗味。
lines.en: The iron on you drowns out the smell of sweat.

lines.zh: 八只眼都盯着你的脚踝。
lines.en: All eight of my eyes are fixed on your ankles.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就当你怕了。
lines.en: You stand still, so I take you for afraid.

lines.zh: 我从没见过这么高的猎物。
lines.en: I have never hunted anything this tall.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我要走的石缝。
lines.en: You crushed the crack I meant to walk through.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好盖住我的洞穴。
lines.en: Your shadow falls right over my burrow.

lines.zh: 你靴底的红土来自我的洞穴。
lines.en: The red clay on your soles came from my cave.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，腿还能动。
lines.en: My shell cracked; the legs still work.

lines.zh: 这点疼，洞穴里天天有。
lines.en: This much pain happens daily in the cave.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我一条腿，我还有七条。
lines.en: You took a leg; I still have seven.

lines.zh: 我的血是冷的，溅不出声。
lines.en: My blood is cold and falls without a sound.

lines.zh: 退到石缝里，你就打不到了。
lines.en: Into the crack, where you cannot reach.

lines.zh: 同伴就在后面，你听得见吗。
lines.en: My partner is behind you; do you hear it?

lines.zh: 二十九点，还剩一点点。
lines.en: Twenty-nine points, and not much left.

lines.zh: 打碎甲壳要付代价。
lines.en: Breaking my shell will cost you.

lines.zh: 我疼得把腿收成一团。
lines.en: The pain curls all my legs into a ball.

lines.zh: 别以为小东西就不会记仇。
lines.en: Do not think a small thing forgets a grudge.

lines.zh: 碎肉的味道比你的靴子香。
lines.en: That scrap of meat smells better than your boots.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在动，我想要。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is moving; I want it.

lines.zh: 把食物放下，我可以先不吃你。
lines.en: Put the food down and I may spare you first.

lines.zh: 洞里的虫子不够塞牙。
lines.en: Cave insects are not enough to fill my fangs.

lines.zh: 那股甜味把我的腿引过去了。
lines.en: That sweetness is pulling my legs toward it.

lines.zh: 你抖落的面包屑落进了沙里。
lines.en: The crumbs you dropped fell into the sand.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，只挑新鲜的。
lines.en: I am not picky; I only choose what is fresh.

lines.zh: 别晃，我看不清你手上的肉。
lines.en: Stop waving; I cannot see the meat clearly.

lines.zh: 为了这一口，我愿意爬出洞穴。
lines.en: For that bite I would crawl out of my cave.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就当你在喂我。
lines.en: Step back and I will take it as feeding.

lines.zh: 你的靴子撞歪了我三根腿。
lines.en: Your boot knocked three of my legs crooked.

lines.zh: 别踩，我的壳经不起这一脚。
lines.en: Do not step; my shell cannot take that.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: You kicked me and I remember it clearly.

lines.zh: 退开，我的獠牙就在你脚边。
lines.en: Back off; my fangs are right at your foot.

lines.zh: 沙子进了我的眼，全怪你。
lines.en: Sand got in my eyes, and that is your fault.

lines.zh: 撞这一下，我掉了半片甲。
lines.en: That bump cost me half a plate of shell.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到了我的洞穴口。
lines.en: Your knee brushed against my burrow entrance.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，因为你不看脚下。
lines.en: I walk against you because you never watch your feet.

lines.zh: 再挤我，我就爬到你背上。
lines.en: Push me again and I climb onto your back.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的同伴听见了。
lines.en: My partner heard that collision from here.

lines.zh: 洞穴角落够暖，适合产卵。
lines.en: The cave corner is warm enough for eggs.

lines.zh: 我们成对出生，也成对守夜。
lines.en: We were born paired and we keep watch paired.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我的伴侣脾气更差。
lines.en: Stay back; my mate has a worse temper.

lines.zh: 细腿碰一碰，我们就懂了。
lines.en: A touch of thin legs and we understand each other.

lines.zh: 她要选最深的石缝下蛋。
lines.en: She will pick the deepest crack to lay eggs.

lines.zh: 等这批卵孵出来，洞穴就满了。
lines.en: When these eggs hatch, the cave will be full.

lines.zh: 我替她守着洞口，直到天亮。
lines.en: I guard the entrance for her until dawn.

lines.zh: 蛛形动物的礼数是安静地并排走。
lines.en: Arachnid courtesy is walking quietly side by side.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们只在这季相聚。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we meet only this season.

lines.zh: 八条腿交叠，算是拥抱了。
lines.en: Eight legs overlapping is how we embrace.

lines.zh: 这根胫骨，我拖回巢里磨牙。
lines.en: This shinbone goes home for my teeth to grind.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西，我拖回洞里。
lines.en: Whatever was dropped, I drag it home.

lines.zh: 我用两只前腿抱着它走。
lines.en: I carry it with my two front legs.

lines.zh: 发亮的小东西，我要收藏。
lines.en: Shiny little things, I want to keep them.

lines.zh: 你的面包屑正好填肚子。
lines.en: Your crumbs will do as a meal.

lines.zh: 洞里的收藏品又多了一件。
lines.en: One more treasure for my cave collection.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的皮，我想尝尝。
lines.en: Leather on the ground, I want a taste.

lines.zh: 东西太沉，我拖着走。
lines.en: Too heavy to lift, so I drag it.

lines.zh: 松手，我的前腿已经搭上去了。
lines.en: Let go; my front legs are already on it.

lines.zh: 我把铁片垫在卵下面。
lines.en: I line my eggs with that iron scrap.

lines.zh: 我闻到你，就不追别人了。
lines.en: I caught your scent; no one else interests me.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的洞穴范围了。
lines.en: You have stepped inside my burrow's range.

lines.zh: 五点半的伤害，够开始这场追逐。
lines.en: Five and a half points, enough to start this chase.

lines.zh: 目标很大，但腿脚很慢。
lines.en: The target is huge, but the legs are slow.

lines.zh: 八只眼同时锁住你。
lines.en: Eight eyes lock onto you at once.

lines.zh: 传说维度的规矩：先看见的归自己。
lines.en: Legend rules: whoever spots it keeps it.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道在洞里散开了。
lines.en: Your scent has spread through the whole cave.

lines.zh: 别跑，我在地底比你熟。
lines.en: Do not run; I know the underground better.

lines.zh: 我选中你，我的伴侣也同意。
lines.en: I chose you, and my partner agrees.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声让我改了方向。
lines.en: Your footsteps made me change direction.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那个走最后的人。
lines.en: I have picked the one walking last.

lines.zh: 沙下的震动告诉我你多大。
lines.en: Vibrations in the sand tell me your size.

lines.zh: 别回头，我就在你脚后跟。
lines.en: Do not turn; I am at your heels.

lines.zh: 你的靴印越深，我追得越准。
lines.en: The deeper your prints, the better I track.

lines.zh: 我绕到石头后，等你自己靠近。
lines.en: I slip behind the rock and wait for you.

lines.zh: 洞穴的回声把你放大了三倍。
lines.en: The cave makes your echo three times bigger.

lines.zh: 你逃到光亮处，我就在暗处等。
lines.en: Run to the light; I wait in the dark.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸调整脚步。
lines.en: I pace my steps to the count of your breath.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝隙我看见了。
lines.en: I have found the gaps in your armor.

lines.zh: 别爬高，我会跟着上去。
lines.en: Do not climb; I will follow you up.

lines.zh: 我贴地走，你的箭射不中。
lines.en: I hug the ground, out of your arrows' path.

lines.zh: 丛林里落下的叶子替你报信。
lines.en: Falling jungle leaves report your position.

lines.zh: 耐心是我的毒，比牙更慢。
lines.en: Patience is my venom, slower than my fangs.

lines.zh: 再走十步，你就到我的石缝了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you reach my crack.

lines.zh: 牙刺进靴子，我尝到铁。
lines.en: My fangs sink into the boot; I taste iron.

lines.zh: 这一口，五点半的疼。
lines.en: This bite carries five and a half points of pain.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝往上爬。
lines.en: I bite your ankle and climb upward.

lines.zh: 小小的身体，也能撕开皮。
lines.en: A small body can still tear skin open.

lines.zh: 别甩，我的牙卡在里面。
lines.en: Do not shake; my fangs are stuck inside.

lines.zh: 你出血了，洞穴会记住的。
lines.en: You are bleeding, and the cave will remember.

lines.zh: 我同伴绕到你另一边了。
lines.en: My partner has circled to your other side.

lines.zh: 第一口只是打招呼。
lines.en: The first bite is only a greeting.

lines.zh: 三十点血的我，咬穿你的护腿。
lines.en: Twenty-nine life points, and I still bite through leggings.

lines.zh: 咬完我就退，石缝里更安全。
lines.en: After biting I retreat; the crack is safer.

lines.zh: 洞顶落下一撮沙，我来了。
lines.en: A pinch of sand falls and here I am.

lines.zh: 传说维度又分给我一条石缝。
lines.en: The Legend dimension gave me another crack.

lines.zh: 两只一起出现，是这儿的规矩。
lines.en: Appearing in pairs is the rule down here.

lines.zh: 我从最深的地底爬上来了。
lines.en: I have climbed up from the deepest ground.

lines.zh: 权重一百，我总能被选中。
lines.en: A weight of one hundred, so I am always chosen.

lines.zh: 这片森林的落叶下有我的卵。
lines.en: My eggs lie under this forest's fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 洞穴刚空出来，我就占了。
lines.en: The cave just emptied, and I took it.

lines.zh: 沙地、丛林、洞穴，我都不挑。
lines.en: Sand, jungle, or cave: I am not picky.

lines.zh: 八只眼刚睁开，就看见你。
lines.en: Eight eyes just opened and found you.

lines.zh: 黑暗里长出的东西，都归传说。
lines.en: Things grown in darkness belong to the Legend.

lines.zh: 火燎到甲壳，噼啪作响。
lines.en: Flame on my shell crackles like dry wood.

lines.zh: 从洞顶摔下来，我晕了一会。
lines.en: Falling from the ceiling, I black out a moment.

lines.zh: 水灌进石缝，我的腿乱蹬。
lines.en: Water fills the crack and my legs thrash.

lines.zh: 石块砸下来，我的壳凹了一块。
lines.en: Falling rock dented my shell in one spot.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的壳，卡在肉里。
lines.en: The arrow pierced my shell and lodged in flesh.

lines.zh: 那股味道让我甲壳发麻。
lines.en: That strange smell numbs my whole shell.

lines.zh: 洞里的虫子越来越少。
lines.en: The insects in this cave grow fewer.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，八只眼都白了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and all eight eyes went white.

lines.zh: 虚空没有石壁，我的腿无处抓。
lines.en: The void has no walls for my legs to grip.
